This plot is small — only a quarter hectare — and I am growing something other than the main cereals, so I do not think the fertilizer package from the cooperative is worth the cash for this plot. I will put manure from our animals on it instead, since we have some to spare, and use the seed I saved from last season like I always do. I will do most of the work with my family, but during weeding I may call on a neighbor for a couple of days to help us keep up.
